profile.description: EML Group is one of the oldest Australian personal injury insurers with history dating back to 1910. The service range of this company is only in Australia, with over 3,500 specialists operating in New South Wales, South Australia and Victoria.
profile.description_zh: EML集团是澳大利亚最古老的人身伤害保险公司之一，历史可追溯至1910年。该公司服务范围仅限于澳大利亚，在新南威尔士州、南澳大利亚州和维多利亚州拥有超过3500名专家。
